test_external_value_sensor: test the ExternalValueSensor class by creating a sensor with an initial numpy array value
create_external_value_sensor: create an ExternalValueSensor with a name and initial numpy array value for observation
set_sensor_value: set a new numpy array value on an ExternalValueSensor instance using set_value
get_observation_key: get the observation key string from an ExternalValueSensor using get_obs_key
run_parameterized_sensor_test: run the parameterized test_external_value_set test with different initial and set numpy array values
